title: Yellow Smoked Croatian Lamb Tagine
description: A winey and aerated Croatian dish featuring hot smoked paprika, this midnight-craving tagine is made with air-fried lamb and cooked in a ceramic tagine vessel, following ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly principles.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb cubes with salt, black pepper, and hot smoked paprika.
Air-fry the lamb cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch.
Heat the olive oil in the ceramic tagine vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the tagine vessel and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the tagine vessel and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb cubes, dry white wine, and chicken broth to the tagine vessel.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
